tools_helpful.evidence: TURN 12 fetched the 'background-tasks', 'windowing', and 'threading' anchors to resolve TODOs before editing.
TURN 53: ran 9 checks incl. manifest Windows.Desktop+runFullTrust and dotnet build (306 warnings, 0 WUI) — all PASS.

tool_limitations.limitation: Its manifest check (5b) only validates TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust; it does NOT verify that a declared windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint has a matching windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer registration, so the 0x80080204 defect was only caught later at Test-AppLaunch.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a static manifest check: every non-audio windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint must have an ActivatableClassId under windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer.

doc_errors.wrong: Only says IBackgroundTask/BackgroundTaskRegistration 'are not the recommended model' and to use BackgroundTaskBuilder or push activation — implies the in-process WinRT model should always be replaced.
doc_errors.correct: For trigger types still bound to the in-process WinRT model (e.g. DeviceUseTrigger, DeviceServicingTrigger), the correct migration is to KEEP IBackgroundTask and register the task class in the manifest via windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer alongside the windows.backgroundTasks extension.

special_apis.special_handling: Retained as-is in WinUI 3; the packaged desktop manifest must add a windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer Extension whose ActivatableClassId equals the backgroundTasks EntryPoint, else package registration fails with 0x80080204.

errors_encountered.error: winapp run registration failed: 0x80080204 'If it is not an audio background task, it is not allowed to have EntryPoint="BackgroundTask.Scenario1_BackgroundTask" without ActivatableClassId in windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer.'
errors_encountered.root_cause: The migrated manifest kept the UWP windows.backgroundTasks Extension (EntryPoint pointing at the in-process WinRT IBackgroundTask class) but a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app additionally requires that class to be registered as an in-process COM server via windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer. UWP registered it implicitly; WinUI 3 does not.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Clean dotnet build (0 errors, 0 WUI warnings) but Test-AppLaunch failed AppX registration with 0x80080204.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The background-tasks migration pattern gave no guidance for the case where the in-process WinRT task is retained, and no script/checklist flagged the missing windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer registration.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent read the error text, inferred the required inProcessServer extension, and added it; re-validated to PASS.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add the inProcessServer manifest requirement to the Background Tasks pattern + Manifest migration checklist, and add a Validate-UwpMigration static check so it is flagged before launch.
